content: Ferisio Sadyusio yalaa Jisas kat vɨlaa yelavɨtndi. Ndɨ nyinangwupmba lɨga yandɨ? E? Nyinangwupmba lɨga ana yandɨ. Ndɨ kɨpmana nyana waa yelavɨtaa wandi ndɨ kat. Nɨma apma njɨvwa agwut. Kwupmɨn maa vɨlaa nyinangwupmba ya nyana waa yelavɨkiyanɨn waa wandi.
Jisas ndi kat wandɨ. Nglaambu nya ndaindɨ, vɨlaa nyinangwut yelogwen mbangɨ lɨndɨ maa vɨlaa walɨgangwuk. nyinangwut yelogwen mbangɨ lɨgandɨ. Kinya meik ana ndaigandɨ waa walɨgangwuk.

Ngambi nya wokendɨ, vɨlaa nyinangwut yelogwen mbangɨ lɨndɨ maa vɨlaa walɨgangwuk. Mbambala meik ndaigandɨ waa walɨgangwuk. Nyinangwut vɨlaa ngɨni yaiga meik mwuk tat vɨga lɨgangwuk. Manda kat kwutawa njɨvwa vɨlaa yetuwa vak kat ana vɨga lɨgangwuk.

Kan mbambala lɨga ndu lagwu Godna vak vɨlapman kavle vat yiga yetɨlɨga nɨmba ndi. Nɨma apma njɨvwa agwup mɨla waa wun kat wangwuk. Ana kwukiyowun. Nɨma nyɨvwa kɨta mɨna kwuikiyowun. Tamba la nyan Jona kwukna vak vla mɨna kwukwun, vɨgiyangwuk waa wandɨ Jisas. Wandi maa Jisas kat kwagalalaa yindi.
FERISIO SADYUSINA YIS
Jisas ndɨna mbaapma nɨmbagwi njaambɨt kulaa sak valɨgendi. Kɨgɨnda klalapman maawut tɨvɨga kwagalalaa kwo yindi.
Jisas ndi kat wandɨ. Ferisiogwi Sadyusina bretmba taagalɨnja yis ke klaga. Kavle nda wandɨ.
Wandɨ maa ndɨna mbaapmamba la nɨmba awat sowat yelavɨka ngambulɨndi. manda kat kupma wandɨ. Kɨgɨnda klalapman yanangat anagandɨ waa waa yelavɨka ngambulɨndi.
Jisas ngambulɨnja vak kat wutaa wandɨ. Kɨgɨnda klalapman yangwa vak kat manda kat ngambulɨgangwuk. Kɨgɨnda kat manda kat nɨmamba yelavɨka lɨgangwuk.
Njambwi nyanat tuwa vat ngwuk ana nɨmamba yelavɨka lɨgangwuk. Tat bret-nao tambanat klalaa 5,000 ta nɨmba kat kwiwun maa kɨndi. Kɨndi mala kɨlambɨnja kɨgɨnda angamala mbanimba naangangwuk.
Nat njambɨ bret-nao sɨla vɨli klalaa 4,000 ta nɨmba kat kwiwun maa klalaa kɨndi. Kɨndi mala kɨlambɨnja kɨgɨnda mbani angamala naagangwuk.
Tat ngwuk kat wowun. Ferisogwi Sadyusina bretmba taagalɨnja yis ke klaga wowun. Kɨlɨnja bret-nao kat ana wowun waa wandɨ Jisas.
Wandɨ maa ndɨna mbaapmamba la nɨmba maawupmba yelavɨka lɨndi. Bretmba taagalɨnja yis kat ana wandɨ. Ferisio Sadyusio mbutɨga nyaangɨt ngwuk ke wuka waa wandɨ waa yelavɨkaw lɨndi.
MƗN KRAIST MƗN WAA JISAS KAT WANDƗ PITA

Jisas Sisaria Filipai walɨnja ngepmana ngwayat yindɨ. Ndɨna mbaapmamba la nɨmbo ndɨno kɨta vat yindi. Jisas ndi kat wagalandɨ. Wun Godna vak sɨmogwi lɨga nyan wun kat ndu lagwa anda sɨmba walɨgandi waa wagalandɨ maa wandi.
Nat nɨmba ndɨ ngu yagu lɨga Jona waa mɨn kat walɨgandi. Nat nɨmba ndɨ Jeremaia waa mɨn kat walɨgandi. Nat nɨmba ndɨ profetna waa mɨn kat walɨgandi waa wandi.
ma Jisas ndi kat wagalandɨ. Ngwuk wun kat angamak walɨgangwuk waa wagalandɨ.
Pita ndɨ kat wandɨ. Mɨn nɨn kat kwunapmak ya nyan mɨn. Mɨn Godna nyan mɨn waa wandɨ Pita.
Wandɨ, Jisas ndɨ kat wandɨ. Saimon, Jonana nyan mɨn apma maawut yelavɨka lɨgamɨn. Maawupmba yelavɨtɨma vak nat nyanananmba ana klamɨn. Nyinangwupmba lɨga wuna nyaek mɨn kat mbutndɨ, wamɨn.
Mɨn kambak vla lɨgamɨn. Wuna mbaapmamba tɨgiya nɨmba kɨngi kambapmba veiga laataa lɨgiyandi. Wundumbu yinjeyan wuna mbaapmamba veilapman tɨgiya nɨmba ngɨni kavle yigiyandi.

Nginangwuk wuleilɨnja ndaamangemba lɨga mbapmona ki mɨna lak taagagiyowun. Kan kɨpmamba lɨga nɨmba kat kemapmeyan ndi ana wuleigiyandi. Kan kɨpmamba lɨga wuleigiyangwuk wameya nɨmba ndi wuleigiyandi waa wandɨ Jisas Pita kat.
Pita kat walaa ndɨna mbaapmamba la nɨmba kat aywaa ndi kat wandɨ. Ndinyangu kat kwunapmat ya nyan Kraistnat tuwa vat nat nɨmba kat ke mbukngwa wandɨ.
KIYALAA LƗGA LAAKIYOWUN WAA WANDƗ JISAS

Wan njɨmbla Jisas kɨta nyaangɨt ndi kat ngambundɨ. Ngambuga wandɨ. Samat tɨga Jerusalemat yigiyowun. Yiwun maa Judana njambwi nɨmbo God kat kwunatɨga njambwi nɨmbo Moses kwiya nyaangɨt sɨmogwi lɨga nɨmbo wun kat kwutaa kavle vat yigiyandi. Kavle vat yiga wun kat kwutaa vatnyagiyandi. Kiyalaa nandinya kuvut tɨga laakiyowun waa wandɨ maa wutaa
Pita ndɨ kat kwuknat kalilaa wandɨ. Njambwi nyan wama vat ana nglaatndɨ. Manda kat wupma wamɨn. Wan kavle vat mɨn kat wupma yilandi waa wandɨ maa

Jisas Pita kat wandɨ. Seten mɨn wun kat kwagalalaa ay. yiweya yambɨ kat mɨn ke tɨvɨlɨga. Yelavɨtɨma vak Godna vak ana ndɨ. Ndinyanguna vakna yelavɨtɨma waa ndɨ kat walaa ndɨna mbaapmamba la nɨmba kat wandɨ.
Kɨta nyan wuna mbaapma wuleivat wandeyan avla ndɨna mbangɨ kwunapmak kat kai walaa kwutuwa njɨvwa ndɨno kwukiyandɨ.
Kɨta nyan ndɨna mbangɨ kwunapmak mɨna yelavɨka lɨndeyan kavle yigiyandɨ. Kɨta nyan wuna njɨvwa kwuka yetɨga kiyandeyan ndɨ apma vat tɨgiyandɨ.

Kɨta nyan kɨpmana kwanda kwanda nda aywaa klalaa kavle vat yiga yetɨndeyan wan apma vatna? Kai. Apma vat ana ndɨ. Kavle vatna. Njɨmbla njɨmbla apma vat tɨnjeya vat kɨta nyan wenga kwilaa ana klaigandɨ.
Wun Godna vak sɨmogwi lɨga nyan samat tɨga enselonala yaigowun. Wuna nyaek wun kat ndɨna kwondu kwindɨ maa yaigowun. Yalaa ndinyangu aywaa kwutɨnja njɨvwa kat wenga kwigiyowun.
Ngwuk wutaa yelavɨk ngwula. Ngwutna nat nɨmba kwo lɨga njambwi nyanat tɨga yaweya vat vɨgiyangwuk. Wun Godna vak sɨmogwi lɨga nyan wun yaweya vak vɨgiyangwuk waa wandɨ Jisas.
